He booked a desk at the evening study room and copied the opening hours into his notebook. The result notice would arrive two weeks after the test, before the next course registration period closed at the end of the following month. He imagined another result below the required mark. The possibility waited behind every practice page, making the weeks ahead feel like a corridor returning to the same locked door.

emotional: Jaya submitted an application for her dance group to perform at the neighbourhood festival. The committee would select groups in a month, and there were fewer slots than applicants. She sent a recording of their recent rehearsal and checked the confirmation receipt. The group had performed at the festival for several years. Jaya entered the announcement date in the rehearsal calendar and listed the costume materials already ordered. The committee requested no additional documents. She saved the receipt beside the recording and returned to the page containing the next rehearsal schedule and attendance list. She pictured the programme printed without their name. The absent line began to follow her through rehearsals, as though the group were already practising for an empty space.
